content:
Maya: Heads-up - relaunch plan for newsletter: target dormant segments with a short re-engagement/drip. Proposing 3-touch micro-sequence over 10 days, then move to suppressed. Thoughts?

Jon: Sounds good. Can you spell out the cadence per dormancy bucket? Also we should split test subject and CTA.

Maya: Draft cadence: 0-30d = single soft nudge at 48h; 30-90d = 48h, 5d, 10d; >90d = immediate re-engage + final 7d nudge then suppress. Subjects: two lightweight variants.

Ravi: For routing, when a user clicks and has >2 product page views in the past 7 days, create a CRM lead with tag "reengage_intent" and push to sales webhook. Don't want to miss warm prospects.

Elena: I'll set the CRM tag and make the webhook mapping. Sales wants a short lead note: "Clicked re-engage email + product interest; suggest intro call".

Maya: Copy options (short):
- A: "Quick update from Redwood Inference"
- B: "New benchmarks + a 1-min update"
- C (EU): "Account updates & privacy note"
We'll A/B A vs B for opens; C reserved for EU sends with adjusted privacy line.

Jon: Deliverability plan: canary 5% across our IPs, ramp to 35% in 4h, 100% next day if metrics OK. Send windows by region: NA 10-2 PT, EMEA 10-2 CET, APAC 10-2 SGT.

deliverability-bot: Recent stats: hard_bounce=0.45%, soft_bounce=1.1%, complaint_rate=0.025%. Recommend suppress domains with >4 bounces and refresh suppression list before send.

Ravi: For tracking: utm_campaign=newsrel_reengage_ut, utm_content=subjectA/subjectB + ctaA/ctaB. Landing pages: benchmarks vs product-tour. We'll split CTA to measure top-of-funnel qualification.

Maya: SQL to build cohorts (Ravi to validate):
```sql
SELECT id AS user_id, email, last_opened_at, region, product_page_views_7d
FROM newsletter_subscribers
WHERE subscribed = true
  AND unsubscribed = false
  AND (last_opened_at IS NULL OR last_opened_at < now() - INTERVAL '30 days')
  AND email NOT IN (SELECT email FROM suppression_list)
```
Cohorts: 0-30d, 30-90d, 90+.

Ravi: I'll join product_page_views and produce a canary export. Also will add a flag for high-intent routes.

Elena: QA checklist before canary: confirm links, verify utm params, test regional send windows, import suppression list, and inbox previews for Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo.

Maya: Timeline: canary Monday 10am PT, evaluate for 24h, ramp Tue 10am PT, full send Wed if green. I'll own approval.

Jon: Also suggest limiting sends to max 3 in a rolling 7-day window for any recipient. Historical data shows complaint spikes beyond that.

Elena: Sales playbook name: "reengage_inbound". Webhook payload will include top_pages and last_7d_views. I'll put mapping in the playbook doc.

deliverability-bot: Reminder: stagger sends by IP pools to avoid sudden ISP throttles. Canary should sample across pools.

Maya: Great. Ravi/Elena please share canary export + webhook mapping by EOD. Jon will prepare deliverability ramp plan. We'll reconvene here with screenshots of the two subject variants and the landing page previews. Thanks! :rocket:
